title: lamium purpureum subsp. hybridum
intro: Lamium purpureum subsp. hybridum, commonly known as Purple Deadnettle, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family, Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, where it has been traditionally used to relieve stress, anxiety, and insomnia, as well as to reduce inflammation and promote digestion. The health benefits of Purple Deadnettle are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
